d:
Bihar men mausam ka mijaj dhire-dhire badal raha hai. subah aur sham ke samay halki thand mahsus hone lagi hai, vahin subah ke vakt kaee ilakon men kohra bhi dekhne ko mil raha hai. pradesh men tapman men utar-charhav ka daur jari hai. is bich mausam vibhag ne apna taja purvanuman jari kiya hai. iske mutabik, kal rajy ke do jilon men halki barish hone ki sanbhavna hai. aise men aaie jante hain ki kin jilon men barish ho sakti hai aur baki hisson men mausam kaisa rahega.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
